item.title: WRE News: Miami Condo Prices Hit Three-Year Low as Market Begins to Stabilize
item.description: Miami, FL - January 11, 2025 - Across South Florida, falling prices, rising inventory and lower mortgage rates are helping stabilize condo sales, with Miami-Dade standing out as a key bellwether, according to WLRN Public Media. item.title: WRE News: Stephen Ross Says Miami Dolphins Draw Near–$15 Billion Offers
item.description: Miami, FL - January 15, 2026 - Miami Dolphins owner Stephen Ross says the NFL franchise has become so valuable that buyers have floated offers approaching $15 billion—yet he has no intention of selling. Speaking at a Bloomberg event in Florida, Ross underscored his belief that there is “no better asset than a football team,” citing the NFL’s ever-expanding media rights deals and growing competition from streamers as key drivers of soaring valuations.
